preConditions.onFailMessage: CM-BPMN-ONLY-LEGACY-DATA: archive, remove, or migrate all retained PLAN_MODEL definitions and bindings before upgrading to the BPMN-only release
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM CM_CASE_DEF WHERE ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = 'PLAN_MODEL' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING WHERE ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = 'PLAN_MODEL' )

changeSet.author: casemgmt
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF DROP CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CASE_DEF_MODE
ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CASE_DEF_MODE CHECK (ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = 'BPMN')
ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF MODIFY ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ DEFAULT 'BPMN'
ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING DROP CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDB_MODE_V2
ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDB_MODE_V2 CHECK (ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = 'BPMN')
ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING MODIFY ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ DEFAULT 'BPMN'
